title: MonsoonShield
summary: An AI-powered early warning platform that forecasts water-borne disease outbreaks 14 days ahead for wards in Coimbatore, combining NASA/weather data with Prophet and XGBoost risk models and a 3D dashboard. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, imported via sdv.single_table, to generate extreme synthetic sensor scenarios for stress-testing risk predictions.
evidence: ml_engine.py:49-53 imports CTGANSynthesizer/SingleTableMetadata from sdv; dependencies.py:85 loads a trained CTGANSynthesizer via sdv.single_table
needs: Could not confirm from evidence whether CTGAN training actually runs end-to-end (train function referenced at ml_engine.py:240) versus being optional/gracefully degraded.
